properties.name: cloudinary.name
properties.description: The cloud name from your Cloudinary account used for identifying your cloud storage space. Found in your Cloudinary dashboard

properties.name: cloudinary.key
properties.description: The API Key from your Cloudinary account used for authentication. Found in your Cloudinary dashboard under Account Details

properties.name: cloudinary.secret
properties.description: The API Secret from your Cloudinary account used for request signing. Found in your Cloudinary dashboard under Account Details

properties.name: stripe.secret
properties.description: The Secret Key from your Stripe account used for API authentication. Found in your Stripe dashboard under Developers > API keys

properties.name: rsa.key.paths
properties.description: Path to the RSA public/private key pair files used for JWT signing and verification. Format should be: 'private-key.pem,public-key.pem' relative to resources/keys directory
